history.prompt: Overhead flat-lay photograph of a thick, heavy corporate service contract bound in dark textured cardstock, resting on a plain dark matte desk surface. A single, small copper coin sits isolated on the massive document, symbolizing a tiny fractional payout. Top-down 90-degree view, even diffused daylight casting soft contact shadows. One page is slightly out of alignment to look handled. Muted paper tones, sophisticated editorial color palette, razor-sharp focus on the metallic coin and the heavy paper grain, generous negative space.

Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look. A wide establishing composition of a darkened enterprise data center aisle during an outage. In the foreground, a single smaller secondary server rack hums with warm amber indicator lights, representing a critical self-built fallback system. Deep atmospheric haze, restrained teal-and-amber palette, prominent rim highlights on the brushed metal server blades. Single strong practical light source casting deep shadows across the inactive primary racks. Moody editorial atmosphere, quiet confidence.

style_when: the article describes one decisive moment or place — a yard at dawn, a control room, a shutdown line, a handover — that a film still could hold
prompt: Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm look, wide establishing composition. A massive enterprise data hall receding into deep atmospheric haze. Thousands of server blades glow with blue and green indicator lights, but one isolated rack in the asymmetrical foreground is ominously dark, dead, and unlit. Deep shadows, a single strong practical light source casting cold light across the metal grates, restrained teal-and-amber palette. Unbranded brushed aluminum hardware, heavy tactile infrastructure. Motion implied by cooling fan exhaust. No people, quiet confidence, editorial restraint.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, logos, watermarks, people, faces
rationale: A cinematic still of a massive data center grounds the abstract concept of cloud SLAs into the physical reality of server infrastructure. The dramatic lighting emphasizes the weight and risk of relying entirely on a single vendor's hardware.
subject: A single darkened server rack in a massive illuminated data hall
composition: Asymmetric wide shot with deep perspective
alt_text: Darkened, unlit server rack standing out amidst thousands of glowing servers in a cavernous enterprise data hall.
caption: The gap between a vendor's bill credit and a buyer's actual financial exposure turns redundancy into a critical design choice.
title: Data Center Outage SLA
